children: The stock of Power Grid Corporation of India bounced off a crucial long-term support at ₹245 towards the end of the October. But since the start of November, the price was largely flat. Nevertheless, the stock has seen a good rally in the last two sessions, which shows that buying interest is increasing. Although there is a resistance ahead at ₹272, we anticipate a breakout of this. Post this, there could be an upswing to ₹292 where we might see some consolidation.

Eventually, the stock can surpass this level can appreciate to ₹310 in the medium-term. Buy now at ₹268 and ₹258. Place stop-loss at ₹248. When the stock rises to ₹280 and ₹295, revise the stop-loss to ₹265 and ₹285, respectively. Book profits at ₹310.
(Note: The recommendations are based on technical analysis. There is a risk of loss in trading.)

title: Stock to buy today: Power Grid Corporation of India (₹268.50)
